name: hazen_colloidal_borescope_particle_tracks_sso_2024.hndarray
description: Hazen Lab colloidal-borescope particle tracks in SSO wells M4, M5 and L9, 31 January to 26 February 2024: azimuth, speed and particles in frame for every tracked colloid (52036 readings in 36 measurements)

value.string_value: Source: the 36 borescope log files in ENIGMA team Google Drive 2024_SSO_Borescope Characterization/Borescope Measurements (YYYYMMDD_<well>-<zone>-<depth ft BTOC>[_Pref].log): one line per tracked colloid with the camera clock (local EST, UTC-5), its azimuth (degrees clockwise from north), speed (um/s) and the number of particles in the frame. Well (location ID), port (location), depth below ground surface and the date of the timestamp identify the measurement; hazen_colloidal_borescope_flow_vectors_sso_2024 holds its casing height, start time, weather and the software's summary
